A '''camp''' of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] was located in the [[Banthan Drifts]] of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Under the influence of [[Dark Plague]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eriz Vossan]] performed experiments on augmenting the Sand People in the camp.
